notes.title: Update 0.2.1.9 - New Features, Bug Fixes, and Performance Enhancements!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve just rolled out an exciting new update for our Game! This patch includes new features, improvements, and essential bug fixes.

New Features
- Character Menu
- Stage Menu

Bug Fixes:
- Lobby Related Issue
- Controller Related Issue

Performance Enhancements:
- Added New Graphic Settings (Foliage Distance and Grass Density)
- Fix default preset is too heavy (Render Scale is heavy, so be careful)

We’d like to extend a huge thank you to everyone for playing and supporting our game! Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, and we’re always looking to improve. If you have any thoughts, suggestions, or run into any issues, please don’t hesitate to share them in our community hub.
